name: protein_structure_prediction_chain
display_name: Protein Structure Prediction — AlphaFold3 / ESMFold / Multimer Validation
description: De novo protein 3D structure prediction using deep learning folding models. Step 1: sequence preprocessing and MSA generation. Step 2: structure prediction with AlphaFold3 or ESMFold (single chain or multimer complex). Step 3: structure validation and quality assessment (MolProbity, pLDDT scoring, Ramachandran analysis). Use this chain for: ab initio folding of unknown structures, multimer complex prediction, protein-protein interface prediction, structure-guided drug design starting points, and homology model generation. This is the correct chain when the goal is a predicted 3D coordinate file (PDB/mmCIF) — NOT for druggability scoring or target tractability assessment.

required_inputs.name: protein_sequence
required_inputs.description: Amino acid FASTA sequence(s) to fold
